## On-demand picture for a post
Makes one picture from a description the current user asked for, using the reviewed Gemini image endpoint and your own stored credential.

It saves the picture into this conversation and shows it in the chat. It never publishes anywhere, never posts to social, and never runs on a schedule. A refusal or a failure is reported plainly instead of being retried.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'gemini-2.5-flash-image', input: [{ type: 'text', text: $json.prompt }], response_format: { type: 'image', mime_type: 'image/png', aspect_ratio: $json.aspectRatio } }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ sessionId: $('Validate Image Request').first().json.sessionId, agentId: 'seo', jobId: $('Validate Image Request').first().json.jobId, prompt: $('Validate Image Request').first().json.prompt, aspectRatio: $('Validate Image Request').first().json.aspectRatio, provider: 'gemini', model: 'gemini-2.5-flash-image', contentType: $json.contentType, imageBase64: $json.imageBase64 }) }}

parameters.jsCode: const i=$('Validate Image Request').first().json,r=$json.response??{ok:false,error:{code:'IMAGE_FAILED',message:'The picture could not be made.'}};return{json:{occurredAt:new Date().toISOString(),sessionId:i.sessionId,requestId:i.requestId,toolName:'generate_image',proposedInput:JSON.stringify({prompt:i.prompt,aspectRatio:i.aspectRatio,jobId:i.jobId}),result:JSON.stringify(r),error:r.ok===false?String(r.error?.message??'Tool failed'):'',response:r}};
const p=$('Prepare Audit').item.json,r={...p.response};if(!Number.isInteger($json.id))r.auditWarning='The picture could not be written to the local audit table.';return{json:r};
